dropped.auth: this PC's credential, never the server's to supply
dropped.baseURL: would point this PC's credentials at another host
dropped.codexInstallationId: this PC's own Codex installation identity
dropped.extraBody: arbitrary fields merged into the request body
dropped.installationId: this PC's own Codex installation identity
dropped.modelMaxOutputTokens: the gateway's own output ceiling for the model, derived on this PC from its provider config and catalog
dropped.requestHeaders: arbitrary headers on this PC's authenticated request (adapters add their own)
dropped.responsesTransport: a provider config setting of this PC (adapters discard it from send options)
dropped.signal: cancellation is this PC-side controller, driven by the channel
dropped.toolExecutionSessionId: native Cursor tool authorization is process-local and the server daemon executes the tools; execute sets it empty so proxied Cursor calls stay ordinary Mixdog tool calls
dropped.transportScope: a process-local connection scope; the server's value is never used (execute allocates and disposes this PC's own for a request that carries one)
